name: Microsoft Entra ID
description: Microsoft Entra ID is Microsoft's cloud identity and access management service for users, groups, applications, devices, authentication, authorization, roles, policies, governance, and access to organizational resources.
agentUseSummary: Connect through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth and let selected agents verify only the signed-in user's minimized Entra identity. Relay does not expose directory-wide users, groups, roles, applications, devices, domains, licenses, authentication methods, policies, logs, reports, privileged identity data, or mutations in V1.

capabilities.label: Read signed-in identity
capabilities.description: Verify and return the signed-in user's Entra object ID, display name, user principal name, and user type.

allowed.label: Read signed-in Entra identity
allowed.description: Call only Microsoft Graph v1.0 /me with a fixed field selection.

blocked.label: Access the directory or change Microsoft Entra ID
blocked.description: Other users, groups, memberships, roles, applications, service principals, devices, domains, licenses, authentication methods, policies, audit or sign-in logs, reports, and all mutations are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One signed-in profile read runs directly. Directory collections, privileged identity data, administrative surfaces, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one fixed Microsoft Graph v1.0 signed-in identity wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.
Railway mounts one fixed Microsoft Graph v1.0 signed-in identity wrapper through Relay-owned Microsoft OAuth.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's multi-tenant Entra application has not been configured and accepted for the exact Microsoft Entra ID callback and delegated User.Read permission, and no organizational tenant has completed consent and acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console owner updates Relay's verified multi-tenant Entra application, adds the exact callback, grants delegated Microsoft Graph User.Read, stores the client ID and secret in Railway, then validates OAuth, refresh, the minimized /me read, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in a non-production organizational tenant.

evidence.supports: Microsoft documents Entra ID as the identity and access platform for users, applications, roles, authentication, devices, governance, and organizational resources.
Microsoft documents the stable Graph v1.0 /me endpoint, $select minimization, and User.Read as its least-privileged delegated permission.
Microsoft documents delegated User.Read as sign-in and signed-in profile access without administrator consent.
Microsoft documents Graph 429 throttling behavior and Retry-After guidance; Relay exposes one non-paginated identity request per invocation and maps throttling safely.
